meta.name: Beyond the Bar
meta.description: A young, rookie lawyer with a strong sense of justice joins a top law firm — navigating the complex legal world under a cold, demanding mentor.

videos.title: Induction
videos.overview: Despite a rocky start at Yullim Law Firm, Kang Hyo-min joins Yoon Seok-hoon's team — and impresses him when she finds a discrepancy in their first case.

videos.title: Hot Water Is the Test for Tea and Love
videos.overview: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min take on a case involving a man who broke into a fertility clinic — earning trust in a tangled battle of love, health and injustice.

videos.title: Butterfly Chrysalis
videos.overview: A complex no-contact car accident involving a child sends Seok-hoon and Hyo-min digging for clues. Seok-hoon receives a bold offer from Yullim's founder.

videos.title: Lex Talionis
videos.overview: While defending a CEO accused of child abuse, Hyo-min and Seok-hoon clash over their morals. Soon, Seok-hoon's sudden disappearance worries her.

videos.title: Salieri's Monologue
videos.overview: Hyo-min takes on her first solo case over a painting's copyright, leaning on Seok-hoon for mentorship — until a mid-trial revelation shakes her stride.

videos.title: Love Is an Impairment
videos.overview: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min handle a tricky consent case for a client suing her ex. Meanwhile, Kwon Na-yeon's sudden appointment creates waves at Yullim.

videos.title: Love in All Its Colors
videos.overview: After a man is arrested for aiding his wife's assisted suicide, Seok-hoon takes on the case. Meanwhile, Yullim's new performance system sparks fury.

videos.title: Wonder Woman
videos.overview: At Yullim, Ko Tae-seop's plot to oust Seok-hoon escalates. When a famous news anchor is charged with assaulting her husband, Hyo-min digs for the truth.

videos.title: The Right to Life
videos.overview: Seok-hoon and Hyo-min defend a doctor who faces possible murder charges for failing to save a man she abhors. Meanwhile, Na-yeon looks into a shady deal.

videos.title: Bystander
videos.overview: After a murder suspect blames her for the crime, Hyo-min hunts for their connection. Na-yeon and Seok-hoon pursue the truth behind Yullim's CEO's ploy.

videos.title: The Two-Legged Beast
videos.overview: When a personal privacy case spirals, Seok Hun's fury grows as the client crosses the line. Meanwhile, Na Yeon uncovers proof to back her suspicions.

videos.title: Beyond Love's Vow
videos.overview: A divorce case turns complicated when the court contemplates their unusual relationship. Seok Hun and Na Yeon make their final move for justice.
